about: Explicit exceptions to the as-data gate. `allow`: one row per file + kind + literal (kind: number | label | compare | name-compare | data-id), each with a reason of 12+ characters; a row nothing matches is stale and fails the gate. Prefer a data row; an entry here is for a value that is not tuning (a protocol constant, a unit). `files`: a WHOLE file exempt from ONE kind (today number only), each with a `category` (baked-geometry | vfx-table | asset-table) and a reason of 12+ characters; a row whose file has no hit of that kind is stale and fails. Only generated or pure-data tables belong here, never code with tuning in it.

Unit conversion: degrees to radians (PI / 180).
